---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to a real testing workflow
title: "[Feature] "
---

## The Task

Who is trying to do what? Give one concrete browser-testing scenario.

## Current Friction

What takes too long, is unclear, or is not possible today?

## Proposed Outcome

Describe the smallest improvement that would solve the problem. Focus on the
user outcome rather than requiring a particular implementation.

## Alternatives

What do you do now? Why is it insufficient?

## Accessibility And Safety

Would this affect keyboard access, screen readers, permissions or sensitive data?

## Safe Example

Use dummy data only. A feature request is feedback, not a release commitment.
